records.description_rewritten: Kalkumer Schlossallee is a car park beside a railway crossing and woodland in Düsseldorf-Kalkum. Gay-szene.net's dated posts on 9 March, 12 May and 19 July 2026 claim current cruising and encounters, with mixed ages and daytime activity. These are self-reported, not independent official observation. The city of Düsseldorf issued a September 2026 tender to convert roughly 1,000 m² of the existing parking area into an EV charging facility; the tender states it was still free public parking before a lease. Construction timing after the 21 October bidding deadline has not been verified, so present parking capacity and forest access must be checked.

independent_or_supplementary_evidence.note: Municipal free car park and nearby woodland; September 2026 EV-hub tender and Oct 21 deadline. No current construction status confirmed.

records.description_rewritten: The archival listing refers to a public toilet at Südfriedhof Düsseldorf. A 13 July 2026 firsthand visitor says the disabled toilet was locked and the other facilities were in poor condition, with no activity observed. Düsseldorf's municipal toilet inventory lists TWO independent cemetery entrance facilities: Am Südfriedhof 16 (An der Vehlingshecke) and (Südring), each with winter 2026 closing at 17:00 but different morning opening times. The source's old mention of 24-hour access to a disabled cubicle contradicts the latest visitor observation and official schedules; exact entry targeted by the original listing remains ambiguous.

independent_or_supplementary_evidence.note: An der Vehlingshecke 6:00–17:00 Nov–Feb, Südring 6:30–17:00 Nov–Feb, distinct entrances and accessibility.

records.description_rewritten: Unterbacher See has two managed bathing beaches and outdoor/woodland paths. The archived cruising source locates its claim in the southern wooded margin near Am Kleinforst, NOT the full lake or a licensed bath. A 1 March 2026 forum post recounts a meeting in August 2025, which happened BEFORE the current 12-month cutoff—so the posting date is recent, but the alleged visit is not. Since 2023 car parking has used numberplate recognition with an initial free 60 minutes followed by fees; municipal records confirm a public WC at Am Kleinforst/Strandbad Süd, but neither establishes cruising. No post-Nov 2025 actual cruise was verified.
